nom: Lancôme Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Serum Eye

segments.oily: The one reviewer who describes her skin as oily but dehydrated says it made the very dry skin around her eyes look smoother and plumper, with some reduction in fine lines.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly find it hydrating and plumping around the eyes, though a couple with very dry or eczema-prone under-eyes say it isn't moisturizing enough alone and layer a heavier cream on top, especially in cold weather.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several, including some with rosacea, report no irritation at all, while others describe stinging, eye redness after accidental contact, a breakout, or irritated eczema flare-ups with no visible results.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s and 50s mostly report firmer, less lined under-eyes within a few weeks, though one reviewer in her mid-30s who had just started noticing fine lines saw no change after three months of daily use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softened fine lines, diminished crow's feet, and firmer under-eye skin, in some cases within days and in others gradually over weeks; a substantial number, however, including one who used it daily for three months, report no improvement or even feel their wrinkles worsened.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including some with dry skin, describe the serum as strongly hydrating with a visible glow around the eyes; dissent comes from a couple of reviewers with very dry or eczema-prone under-eyes who say it isn't moisturizing enough on its own and need to layer a heavier cream on top.
concerns.redness: The one reviewer with rosacea reports no irritation despite her initial concern; separately, another reviewer reports that getting the product in her eye left it visibly red for a full day.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her sunspots starting to diminish after a few weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports no breakouts from the serum, while another with sensitive skin says it made her break out.

aspects.libelle: Stings or burns if it gets in the eye

extraits.texte: Let me preface this review by stating that I was on the search for the best serum that had multiple uses and in my search, this Regenerie H.C.F. Triple Serum consistently came up. I read about all these amazing results that people were having from crows feet diminishing to dark spots disappearing and decided to give it a chance. I have been using this serum every single day for the past three months and have not experienced one change! In fact, I think some of my wrinkles are even getting worse! I'm extremely disappointed, considering the amount of money I paid for this so called "miracle serum". Definitely NOT Lancome's best product.

I was excited to receive a feee sample of this product in exchange for an honest review. Unfortunately, this product didn't really work for me. It stings when I put it on the sensitive skin around my eyes. It also burns if you get it in your eye, and your eye stays red for a full day (for any other clumsy folks). Additionally, I had a hard time getting all three of the products to come out of the packaging, I mostly just got the clear one out.

Thank you to BzzAgent for letting me try Lancôme's Rénergie H.C.F. Triple Eye Serum. I was really looking forward to it because the skin around my eyes has been changing with age and since having kids, and it could use some extra TLC. There are definitely some positives: the serum is very hydrating, it smells nice, and one pump gives you a lot of product. On the flip side, the price is pretty steep, and I found that it irritated my minor eczema flare-ups and sensitive skin. That single pump providing so much product is also a con; I almost always had more than needed for around my eyes, and rubbed it into my 11 lines, and around my mouth. After using it for a month, I didn't see a noticeable difference anywhere, and the minor burning sensation was off-putting. Because of the high cost and the lack of visible results, I wouldn't repurchase this serum. It's not what I would expect based on the description and marketing of the product.

I have been using Renergie H.C.F. Triple Serum for several weeks after receiving a free sample in exchange for my review. The bottle is high end, as you'd expect from Lancome. It has a pump top with three dispensing holes (hence "triple serum"). Per the instructions, I primed the pump by pumping it 8-10 times. Clear serum appeared as in the picture below, and I swirled to mix (even though I couldn't tell if different products were emerging from the dispenser). O.M.G. was this serum hydrating. I was amazed by the how hydrated it made the skin around my eyes feel. It made me think of one of those snail masks I tried once, but not sticky. The word "hydration" just kept coming unbidden to my mind over and over. I used this twice a day for 7 days and then was surprised when some white cream also came out of one or both of the dispensing holes. So this time when I swirled before applying I was actually mixing something. I have used the product for 2 weeks since more than the clear serum came out. It feels nice, but I don't have the overwhelming sensation of hydration I did the first week with just the clear product. I'm a woman in my mid 50's so fine lines and wrinkles around my eyes are a concern. I really feel like this product does more than most to combat the fine lines and wrinkles and promotes elasticity. It has a nice scent, it hydrates, it makes me feel like I'm pampering myself --and let's face it, who doesn't want to be pampered? My only criticism is related to packaging.

extraits.titre: I wanted to love it so much! 😭
extraits.texte: After using this product for a couple weeks I learned that I loved it but it did not like me. It did help keep my under eyes moisturized… it did not do wonders for my bags or dark circles though. I would have had to use it longer to possibly achieving that goal. I was in love with the product even without those results. The thing that made me down a star was that I was heart broken to learn that it made my skin break out. I do recommend for anyone that doesn't have sensitive skin though.

extraits.titre: Definitely adding this to my routine!
extraits.texte: I will definitely buy again! I subscribe to several dermatologists on YouTube and TikTok. Some of them say that you don't really need a separate eye cream or serum; that the serums/creams you use on your face are basically the same thing as eye specific products. I've been doing that for a while now, but this serum is different, and I think the intense hydrating effect makes it worth purchasing a separate product for my eyes. I have an involved skincare regimen using Korean and Japanese products, but I haven't gotten the same amount of plumping around my eyes when using my facial products as eye cream/serum. This serum is lightweight and not greasy. It glides on smoothly and absorbs quickly. It has a clean smell, but it isn't strong. I have oily but dehydrated skin with the skin around my eyes being incredibly dry. This serum definitely made the skin around my eyes look smoother and feel plumper. I have seen some reduction in fine lines under my eyes which appears to be due to the serums plumping effect.

I have been using the triple serum for a few weeks now. I was a bit skeptical at first but, WOW! I have seen a reduction in eye puffiness, fine lines, and dryness. I have rosacea and was concerned about irritation. I am happy to say, I had no problems whatsoever. A few of my coworkers asked if I had botox or something. Nope, just used this triple serum. Highly recommend.
